import numpy as np
rng=np.random.default_rng(6107)
M=np.array([[.85,.65],[0.,-.35]])
C=rng.normal(size=(3,2))
T=rng.normal(size=(5,5))*.2
Q=T@T.T
Qxx=Q[:2,:2];Qxz=Q[:2,2:];Qzz=Q[2:,2:]
L=rng.normal(size=(2,3))
H=rng.normal(size=(2,3,3));H=.5*(H+H.transpose(0,2,1))
omega=.35

def _check_result(value):
    assert len(value)==2, "incorrect number of returned values"
    return value
assert np.allclose(_check_result(quadratic_spectrum(M,C,Qxx,Qxz,Qzz,L,H,omega)), target)
